$comment: Every training PDF and the markdown that goes into it, in print order. Consumed by build.py (renders) and src/lib/training-docs.test.ts (freshness + index coverage). Each output must also appear as a `pdf` in src/lib/training-docs.ts.

role-based onboarding, the Operations & Training Manual with every
module chapter, the seven-chapter training guide, and the install,

outputs.title: Operations & Training Manual
outputs.subtitle: How Rink Reports is organized, every module chapter, and a glossary
blurb: The complete operations manual: how the app is organized, who sees
what, and one chapter per module — Admin Control Center, Daily Reports,
Refrigeration Logs, Incident Reporting, Ice Operations, Air Quality,
Ice Depth, and Employee Scheduling — plus a cross-module glossary.

outputs.title: Complete Training Guide
outputs.subtitle: All modules and the admin console
blurb: A field guide for staff and administrators covering every module:
daily reports, incidents, accidents, ice depth, ice operations,
refrigeration, air quality, dasher boards, communications, scheduling,
and the full admin console — permissions, employees, exports,
retention, audit log, and facility configuration.

outputs.subtitle: Here's how to do your job

outputs.subtitle: Add the app to your home screen

outputs.title: Admin Setup Guide
outputs.subtitle: First-time setup for a facility manager
blurb: A practical, step-by-step path for getting a facility operational:
facility settings, modules, roles and permissions, employees, and
the per-module setup each report flow depends on.

outputs.title: Duplicating Rink Reports
outputs.subtitle: Stand up an independent copy
blurb: How to run your own complete copy of Rink Reports: get the code,
create a fresh Supabase backend and load its schema, connect the two,
and deploy — with a local-only stopping point for evaluation.
